lines.text: What if the market was the game?
We're a small team of gamers and on-chain builders. We grew up on lane battlers, and we watch charts all day. We wanted one place for both.
Crypto culture lives on charts, but it has nowhere to play. Games with real stakes still start with seed phrases, faucets and wallet popups, and only the final result goes on chain.
Monad changes that. Blocks are voted in about three hundred milliseconds and final in under six hundred, so every card can be its own transaction.
Mempire. Stake. Battle. Settle. Every coin is a fighter, the market buffs and nerfs it, and the contract pays the winner.

It's live on Monad testnet: eight verified contracts, passkey sign-up in about ten seconds, staked matches settled on chain, a Chainlink-written meta, Pyth-priced mints, and gasless chests through EIP-7702.
It's for crypto-native players, and the memecoin communities behind every ticker. We reach them through clans: one per community, fighting weekly clan wars.
Mempire. Every coin is a fighter. Play now at mempire-monad dot vercel dot app.
